senses.en: a friend you write letters to
someone you exchange letters with

ex.en: I have a pen-friend in Australia and we write to each other.
ex.zh: 我在澳大利亚有一个笔友，我们互相写信。

ex.en: Having a pen-friend can help you practise writing and learn about other cultures.
ex.zh: 有一个笔友可以帮助你练习写作并了解其他文化。

col: write to a pen-friend｜给笔友写信
tip: pen-friend 与 pen pal 同义；现在也常用 keypal 指电子笔友。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

senses.en: A bag carried on the back using two shoulder straps.
To travel carrying your belongings in a backpack.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in my backpack.
ex.zh: 我把午餐和外套装进了双肩背包。

ex.en: Young adults often backpack through rural regions, supporting small businesses and learning about local traditions.
ex.zh: 年轻人常背包穿行于乡村地区，支持小型商家并了解当地传统。

col: pack a backpack｜整理背包装行李
tip: 指双肩背包；英式英语也常用rucksack。

senses.en: A short test or game involving questions.
To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.

ex.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。

ex.en: A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.
ex.zh: 每节课开始时的小测验可以帮助教师发现学生理解上的不足。

tip: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

senses.en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images
a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

tip: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

senses.en: Behaving badly, especially by disobeying adults

ex.en: The naughty puppy dragged my slippers into the garden.
ex.zh: 那只淘气的小狗把我的拖鞋拖进了花园。

ex.en: Children described as naughty may benefit more from patient guidance than from repeated punishment.
ex.zh: 被说成淘气的孩子可能更需要耐心引导，而非反复惩罚。

tip: 常用于小孩或宠物，通常不表示严重的恶行。

senses.en: A machine carrying people or goods between floors.

ex.en: We took the elevator because our bags were heavy.
ex.zh: 我们的包很重，所以我们乘了电梯。

ex.en: Installing elevators in older apartment buildings can significantly improve accessibility for elderly residents and people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 在老旧公寓楼中安装电梯可以显著方便老年居民和残障人士出入。

tip: 电梯在美式英语中常用elevator，英式常用lift。

senses.en: to look at something carefully to make sure it is right
an act of looking at something to make sure it is correct
to stop something from happening or growing

ex.en: Please check your answers before you hand in the paper.
ex.zh: 交卷前请检查一下你的答案。

ex.en: Scientists check the water quality of the river every month to make sure it is safe for wildlife.
ex.zh: 科学家每月检测这条河的水质，以确保它对野生动物是安全的。

tip: check 后接宾语表示“检查”；check out 是“结账离开”，别混淆。

senses.en: coming last in a series or process
settled and not open to further change or discussion
a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course

ex.en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
ex.zh: 我们装好最后一个箱子，锁上了门。

ex.en: The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.
ex.zh: 研究的最后阶段是比较几种不同类型住房的能源消耗。

tip: finally是副词；final作名词可指决赛或期末考试。

senses.en: A large round fruit with thick skin and sweet, juicy flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她切了一个熟甜瓜，供我们野餐时吃。

ex.en: Farmers growing melons in dry regions often use efficient irrigation systems to reduce water consumption.
ex.zh: 干旱地区种植甜瓜的农民常使用高效灌溉系统来减少用水量。

col: a slice of melon｜一片甜瓜
tip: melon泛指甜瓜类；watermelon专指西瓜。

senses.en: known or recognised by many people

ex.en: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
ex.zh: 暑假期间，我们参观了一座著名的城堡。

ex.en: Well-known tourist destinations often face overcrowding, which can damage historic sites and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 著名旅游目的地常面临过度拥挤的问题，这可能损坏历史遗迹并降低居民的生活质量。

tip: 名词前通常加连字符；表语位置通常写well known。

senses.en: A trained cook working in a restaurant or hotel.

ex.en: The chef added fresh herbs to the steaming soup.
ex.zh: 厨师往热气腾腾的汤里加入了新鲜香草。

ex.en: A skilled chef can design nutritious school meals that appeal to children while staying within a limited budget.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的厨师可以在有限预算内，设计出既营养又受孩子欢迎的学校餐食。

col: train as a chef｜接受专业厨师培训
tip: chef 的 ch 发 /ʃ/；通常指餐馆或酒店的专业厨师。

senses.en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected

ex.en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
ex.zh: 我以为这汤很辣，其实是甜的。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程似乎很方便，但有些学生实际上通过面对面交流学得更好。

tip: actually表示“其实”，不表示“目前”。

senses.en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things
to dry someone or something with a towel

ex.en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
ex.zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。

ex.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.
ex.zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客在入住期间重复使用毛巾，以减少用水量。

tip: 可数名词；paper towel指吸水纸巾，不是布毛巾。

senses.en: the language spoken in many Arab countries
relating to the Arabic language or Arab culture

ex.en: She is learning Arabic so she can read books from the Middle East.
ex.zh: 她正在学阿拉伯语，这样就能读中东的书了。

ex.en: Arabic is written from right to left, which is different from English and Chinese.
ex.zh: 阿拉伯语是从右往左写的，这和英语、汉语不同。

tip: 语言名Arabic首字母大写；阿拉伯数字叫Arabic numerals。

senses.en: One of the five separate parts at the foot's end
The part of a shoe or sock covering the toes

ex.en: There is a little sand stuck between my toes.
ex.zh: 我的脚趾缝里沾了一点沙子。

ex.en: Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.
ex.zh: 穿限制脚趾活动的鞋子可能影响平衡，长此以往还可能导致足部问题。

col: stub your toe｜脚趾撞到硬物
from head to toe｜从头到脚
tip: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

senses.en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.
A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
ex.zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。

ex.en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
ex.zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

tip: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

senses.en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement
a state of quietness or freedom from worry

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。

ex.en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
ex.zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

tip: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

senses.en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance.
To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal.
A sudden increase or spread of something.

ex.en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
ex.zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
ex.zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。

col: a wave of protests｜一波抗议
tip: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

senses.en: Strike someone or something with force.
Affect someone or something badly, often suddenly.
Someone or something that becomes very popular or successful.

ex.en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
ex.zh: 球撞上围栏，又朝我弹了过来。

ex.en: Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨对小企业的打击尤其严重，迫使许多经营者缩短营业时间。

col: a big hit｜大受欢迎的事物
tip: 过去式、过去分词仍为hit；现在分词为hitting。

senses.en: female chicken

ex.en: The hen laid three eggs in the nest this morning.
ex.zh: 母鸡今天早上在窝里下了三个蛋。

ex.en: Farmers keep hens for their eggs and sometimes for their meat.
ex.zh: 农民养母鸡是为了获取鸡蛋，有时也为了鸡肉。

tip: hen是母鸡，公鸡是rooster（美）或cock（英）。

senses.en: To move someone or something to a higher position.
A machine carrying people or goods between floors.
A ride in someone else's vehicle.

ex.en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？

ex.en: Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 在较老的公共建筑中安装电梯，可以方便轮椅使用者和行动不便的人进出。

col: give someone a lift｜让某人搭便车
tip: 电梯英式用lift，美式用elevator。

senses.en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time.
The act of choosing someone for a job or position.

ex.en: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我预约了明天一早看牙医。

ex.en: Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间让员工无需请一整天假就能按预约就医。

col: appointment of a director｜董事的任命
tip: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

senses.en: A British coin or unit worth one hundredth of a pound.
An American coin worth one hundredth of a dollar.

ex.en: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在沙发底下发现了一枚便士硬币。

ex.en: For families on low incomes, every penny saved on energy bills can make a difference.
ex.zh: 对于低收入家庭，能源账单上省下的每一分钱都可能有所帮助。

col: not a penny｜一分钱也没有
tip: 英国金额复数用pence；指多枚硬币用pennies。

senses.en: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar.
A situation where movement stops because things are packed together.
To become stuck, or force something into a tight space.

ex.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。

ex.en: Frequent traffic jams increase air pollution and make daily journeys more stressful for urban residents.
ex.zh: 频繁的交通拥堵加剧空气污染，也让城市居民的日常出行更加令人焦虑。

col: jam something into｜把某物硬塞进
tip: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

senses.en: usually, or in most situations
in the usual, expected, or healthy way

ex.en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
ex.zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.
ex.zh: 学生通常能从定期反馈中受益，尤其是在教师明确指导他们改进作业时。

tip: 既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

senses.en: the main unit of money used in the United Kingdom
a unit of weight equal to about 454 grams
to hit repeatedly with force or beat strongly

ex.en: I paid one pound for this bag of apples.
ex.zh: 我花了一英镑买了这袋苹果。

ex.en: A weaker pound can attract international tourists, but it also raises the cost of imported goods.
ex.zh: 英镑贬值可以吸引国际游客，但也会提高进口商品的成本。

col: a pound of butter｜一磅黄油
tip: 英镑和重量单位磅都用pound；复数通常加s。

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

ex.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
ex.zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。

ex.en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

tip: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

senses.en: To become impossible to see or find.
To stop existing.

ex.en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
ex.zh: 我们看着小船消失在浓雾中。

ex.en: Many traditional crafts may disappear unless governments support skilled workers and encourage younger generations to learn them.
ex.zh: 除非政府支持技艺工人并鼓励年轻一代学习，否则许多传统手艺可能消失。

col: disappear from view｜从视野中消失
disappear without a trace｜消失得无影无踪
tip: 通常是不及物动词，不说 be disappeared。

senses.en: gone by in time; no longer current
the time before now
beyond in time or position

ex.en: She often talks about her past life in the countryside.
ex.zh: 她经常谈起过去在乡下的生活。

ex.en: In the past, people wrote letters to keep in touch, but now they use social media.
ex.zh: 过去人们写信保持联系，但现在他们使用社交媒体。

tip: 注意 past 与 passed（pass 的过去式）发音相同但拼写不同。

senses.en: to press something or move it away by applying force
to strongly encourage or force someone to act
an act of pushing or a determined effort

ex.en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
ex.zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？

ex.en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。

col: push someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
tip: push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

senses.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays.
A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
ex.zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

ex.en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
ex.zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

col: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏
tip: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

senses.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

senses.en: a container for waste in public places

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the litterbin instead of dropping it.
ex.zh: 请把垃圾放进垃圾箱，不要随手乱扔。

ex.en: The city installed more litterbins in the park to keep the environment clean for visitors.
ex.zh: 城市在公园里安装了更多垃圾箱，以保持环境清洁，方便游客。

col: throw sth in the litterbin｜把某物扔进垃圾箱
tip: 英式英语常用 litterbin，美式英语常用 trash can 或 garbage can。

senses.en: a country in northern Europe, with Copenhagen as its capital

ex.en: My cousin moved to Denmark to study architecture.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到丹麦去学习建筑。

ex.en: Denmark offers useful examples of how cycling infrastructure can support healthier and more sustainable urban transport.
ex.zh: 丹麦提供了有益范例，说明自行车基础设施如何支持更健康、更可持续的城市交通。

col: the capital of Denmark｜丹麦首都
tip: 国名前通常不加the；丹麦人为Dane。

senses.en: Coming immediately after seventh in order
One of eight equal parts of something

ex.en: Our apartment is on the eighth floor of this building.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的八楼。

ex.en: The survey ranked public transport eighth among the factors influencing where young professionals choose to live.
ex.zh: 调查显示，在影响年轻专业人士居住地点选择的因素中，公共交通排在第八位。

tip: 序数词前通常用the；eighth末尾的th发/θ/。

senses.en: By good fortune, often avoiding an unpleasant result.

ex.en: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
ex.zh: 我的包掉下来摔开了，幸好没有东西掉出来。

ex.en: The storm damaged several classrooms, but luckily the school had already moved its students to a safer building.
ex.zh: 暴风雨损坏了几间教室，但幸好学校已将学生转移到一栋更安全的建筑中。

col: luckily for us｜对我们来说幸好
luckily no one was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip: 常修饰整个句子，放句首时通常后接逗号。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind

ex.en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。

ex.en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。

col: have a lovely time｜玩得愉快
a lovely person｜友善可亲的人
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。

senses.en: a door or passage used to leave a place
to leave a place or close a computer program

ex.en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
ex.zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。

ex.en: Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.
ex.zh: 公共建筑必须设有清晰可见的紧急出口，以便楼内人员在疏散时安全离开。

tip: 名词指“出口”，动词指“离开”；不要与 exist 混淆。

senses.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.
A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics.
To compete in speed or move very quickly.

ex.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
ex.zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

tip: race可指竞速比赛或种族；不要与民族混同。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。

ex.en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。

col: although it is true that｜虽然确实……
although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: An opening or place through which people enter.
The act of entering or the right to join.

ex.en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
ex.zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。

tip: 某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

senses.en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people
to move away suddenly in fear, especially of a horse

ex.en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
ex.zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。

ex.en: Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 小组讨论可以帮助害羞的学生建立信心，为在全班面前发言做准备。

tip: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。

senses.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice
having a pale yellow colour

ex.en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
ex.zh: 我把半个柠檬的汁挤在烤鱼上。

ex.en: Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.
ex.zh: 在餐食中加入柠檬汁可以增添风味，而不增加盐的摄入量。

col: a slice of lemon｜一片柠檬
tip: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。

senses.en: A portable computer with a screen that folds over its keyboard.

ex.en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。

ex.en: Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备笔记本电脑或许能改善学习资源的获取，但技术支持仍然必不可少。

col: laptop charger｜笔记本电脑充电器
tip: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

senses.en: a country in South Asia

ex.en: My cousin is from India and speaks three languages.
ex.zh: 我的表弟来自印度，会说三种语言。

ex.en: India has a rich cultural history and is home to many different traditions and festivals.
ex.zh: 印度有着丰富的文化历史，是许多不同传统和节日的故乡。

tip: 专有名词，首字母必须大写；注意与 Indian（印度的；印度人）区分。

senses.en: for all future time
very often, especially in an annoying way

ex.en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
ex.zh: 我希望这些阳光明媚的午后能永远持续下去。

ex.en: Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果没有有效的保护措施，一些珍稀动物物种可能在未来几十年内永远消失。

tip: be forever doing常表示不满：老是做某事。

senses.en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
ex.zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。

ex.en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。

col: a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

senses.en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed
a device that keeps something shut until opened correctly
a small section of someone's hair

ex.en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
ex.zh: 上楼前请把后门锁好。

ex.en: Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.
ex.zh: 员工离开办公桌时应锁定电脑，以防机密信息被未经授权的人查看。

col: a lock of hair｜一绺头发
tip: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。

senses.en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
ex.zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。

ex.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
ex.zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。

tip: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。

senses.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen
relating to the nerves in the body

ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
ex.zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

tip: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

senses.en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.
A usual or established way of doing something.
The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.

ex.en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
ex.zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

tip: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

senses.en: the top covering of a building or vehicle
to cover a building with a roof

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
ex.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

col: under one roof｜在同一屋檐下
tip: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。

senses.en: having little distance from one side to the other
limited in range or achieved by only a small margin
to become or make something less wide or extensive

ex.en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
ex.zh: 这条狭窄的小路只容得下我们排成一列走。

ex.en: Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.
ex.zh: 政府应投资乡村学校，缩小城市与偏远社区之间的教育差距。

col: narrow down the options｜缩小选择范围
tip: narrow down表示缩小选择范围，不指道路变窄。

senses.en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.

ex.en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
ex.zh: 我不再坐公交车上学了。

ex.en: Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
ex.zh: 许多员工不再每天通勤，因为雇主如今提供灵活的工作安排。

col: not live here anymore｜不再住在这里
not need it anymore｜不再需要它
tip: 表示“不再”；英式常写any more，数量“更多”须分写。

senses.en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
ex.zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

ex.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
ex.zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

tip: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

senses.en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it.
A hard mass that forms inside an organ.
The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.

ex.en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
ex.zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。

ex.en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
ex.zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。

tip: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

senses.en: A city in southwestern England with a historic port.

ex.en: We walked around the harbour in Bristol yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天在布里斯托尔的港口周围散了步。

ex.en: Bristol provides an interesting example of how historic waterfront areas can be adapted for modern urban life.
ex.zh: 布里斯托尔提供了一个有趣的例子，展示历史悠久的滨水地区如何适应现代城市生活。

col: central Bristol｜布里斯托尔市中心
the city of Bristol｜布里斯托尔市
tip: 重音在首音节；位于英格兰西南部。

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

ex.en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
ex.zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。

ex.en: Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.
ex.zh: 分娩时获得专业医疗护理能显著改善母亲和新生儿的健康状况。

col: the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

senses.en: a narrow street between buildings
a long narrow track for bowling

ex.en: We found a tiny tea shop in a quiet alley.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小巷里找到一家小茶馆。

ex.en: The city plans to clean up the narrow alleys behind the old market to improve safety.
ex.zh: 市政府计划清理旧市场后面的窄巷以改善安全。

col: a blind alley｜死胡同；无出路的办法
tip: blind alley 常比喻“行不通的办法”，写作中可用于论证。

senses.en: in the position after ninth and before eleventh
one of ten equal parts of something

ex.en: Our apartment is on the tenth floor of this building.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的第十层。

ex.en: Only a tenth of the survey participants regularly cycled to work, suggesting considerable scope for improving cycling infrastructure.
ex.zh: 调查参与者中只有十分之一经常骑车上班，这说明自行车基础设施仍有很大的改善空间。

tip: 第十通常用the tenth；十分之一用a tenth。

senses.en: a small public box with a telephone inside

ex.en: He called his parents from a phone-booth near the station.
ex.zh: 他在车站附近的电话亭给父母打了电话。

ex.en: As mobile phones became common, the old phone-booth on our street was finally removed.
ex.zh: 随着手机普及，我们街上那个旧电话亭最终被拆除了。

col: queue for the phone-booth｜排队等电话亭
tip: 英式常说 telephone box；美式拼写 booth 不变。

senses.en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

senses.en: A toothed tool used to arrange or tidy hair.
To tidy hair with a comb, or search an area thoroughly.

ex.en: She pulled a comb from her bag and tidied her hair.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出梳子，梳理了一下头发。

ex.en: Volunteers combed the beach for plastic waste before the start of the summer tourist season.
ex.zh: 暑期旅游季开始前，志愿者仔细搜寻海滩上的塑料垃圾。

tip: 词尾b不发音；comb through表示仔细搜查。

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

ex.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。

ex.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
ex.zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

col: a golf club｜高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部
a round of golf｜一轮高尔夫球
tip: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。

senses.en: making a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds

ex.en: Our noisy washing machine woke everyone up this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，吵闹的洗衣机把大家都吵醒了。

ex.en: Living near noisy roads can affect sleep quality and increase stress among urban residents.
ex.zh: 住在嘈杂的道路附近可能影响城市居民的睡眠质量并加重压力。

tip: noisy是形容词，noise是名词；注意不是nosy。

senses.en: A long seat designed for several people.
A sturdy table used for practical work.
To keep a player out of a game.

ex.en: We shared a park bench and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们一起坐在公园长凳上看鸭子。

ex.en: Installing benches along pedestrian routes can make city centres more accessible to older residents and people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 沿步行路线设置长凳，可以让老年居民和行动不便者更方便地使用市中心空间。

tip: 长凳常无靠背，但并非一定如此；工作台也可用bench。

senses.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.
Information known only to a limited group of people.
An important way of achieving a particular result.

ex.en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。

ex.en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
ex.zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。

col: the secret to success｜成功的秘诀
tip: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.
To get up from sitting or lying down.
An increase in amount, level, or value.

ex.en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
ex.zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。

ex.en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。

col: a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

senses.en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher.
A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。

ex.en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
ex.zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

col: excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生
Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

senses.en: a pain in your back

ex.en: Sitting all day gave my father a bad backache.
ex.zh: 整日坐着使我父亲背部很痛。

ex.en: Students who carry heavy schoolbags often suffer from backache, so doctors advise them to use light bags.
ex.zh: 背沉重书包的学生常受背痛困扰，因此医生建议他们使用轻便的书包。

tip: backache 多作可数，常与 have/get 连用；-ache 结尾的词表示身体某处疼痛。

senses.en: Air moving naturally outdoors.
To wrap something around an object or itself.
To follow a route with many bends and turns.

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
ex.zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

tip: 风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

senses.en: relating to Thailand, its people, or its language
the main language spoken in Thailand
a person from Thailand

ex.en: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭我们一起吃了一道美味的泰式咖喱。

ex.en: Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.
ex.zh: 泰国菜吸引着国际游客，也为当地餐馆和烹饪学校提供了宝贵的机会。

tip: Thai首字母始终大写；泰国是Thailand。

senses.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.
To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.

ex.en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
ex.zh: 我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
ex.zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。

col: be supposed to do｜应该做；按安排做
tip: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

senses.en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches
an area of land covered with trees

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
ex.zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。

ex.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
ex.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

col: a piece of wood｜一块木头
walk in the woods｜在树林中散步
tip: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

senses.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.
Owned or managed independently of the government.
Not intended to be known or shared with others.

ex.en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
ex.zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。

ex.en: Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
ex.zh: 私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。

tip: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

senses.en: the number equal to a thousand thousands

ex.en: The city now has more than a million residents.
ex.zh: 这座城市如今有一百多万居民。

ex.en: The government plans to invest several million pounds in renewable energy projects over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府计划在未来十年向可再生能源项目投入数百万英镑。

tip: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought
Playfully funny in a way that is not serious

ex.en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。

ex.en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
ex.zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。

tip: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

senses.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again
Work done to restore something damaged or broken
To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
ex.zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？

ex.en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
ex.zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。

tip: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

senses.en: to close something or stop being open for business
closed or not open for business

ex.en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
ex.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前把窗户关上。

ex.en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
ex.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民便失去了宝贵的免费学习资源和共享社区空间。

col: shut down a factory｜关闭工厂
keep something shut｜让某物保持关闭
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shut；现在分词为shutting。

senses.en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving.
Used to emphasize that I personally do something.

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
ex.zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。

ex.en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
ex.zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

col: not feel myself｜感觉不在状态
tip: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

senses.en: an island country in the North Atlantic

ex.en: Iceland is famous for volcanoes, geysers and hot springs.
ex.zh: 冰岛以火山、间歇泉和温泉闻名。

ex.en: Many students study how Iceland uses its geothermal energy to heat homes and greenhouses.
ex.zh: 许多学生学习冰岛如何利用地热能取暖和给温室供暖。

col: the capital of Iceland｜冰岛首都
geothermal energy in Iceland｜冰岛的地热能
northern lights in Iceland｜冰岛的极光
tip: 国名和语言首字母大写：Iceland 是冰岛，Icelandic 是冰岛语。

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

ex.en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

col: already in place｜已经就位；已落实
tip: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.

ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
ex.zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
ex.zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

tip: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.en: not open
not available for business or public use
unwilling to consider different ideas

ex.en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
ex.zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。

ex.en: When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 如果当地图书馆周末不开放，上班族家庭获取教育资源的机会就会减少。

col: keep something closed｜使某物保持关闭
tip: 形容词意为“关着的”；也是close的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience.
Knowledge gained through extensive study.

ex.en: Learning becomes easier when I practise a little every day.
ex.zh: 每天练习一点，学习就变得更容易了。

ex.en: Schools can encourage independent learning by giving students opportunities to investigate questions beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生探索常规课程之外的问题，以鼓励自主学习。

col: a steep learning curve｜陡峭的学习曲线
tip: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。

senses.en: the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food

ex.en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，我们去湖边钓鱼了。

ex.en: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 严格限制商业捕鱼能帮助海洋生态系统恢复，并长期支持沿海社区的生计。

tip: 说“去钓鱼”用go fishing，不用go to fishing。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

ex.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。

ex.en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
ex.zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。

tip: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

senses.en: having no doubt about something
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我确信自己把钥匙放在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
ex.zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject
an area of a shop selling a particular type of product

ex.en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 请向我们的销售部门询问送货日期。

ex.en: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
ex.zh: 大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。

tip: 大学的系可用department；学院通常用faculty或school。

senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck

ex.en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
ex.zh: 她戴着一条带有小鸟吊坠的银项链。

ex.en: A handmade necklace can reflect local traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
ex.zh: 一条手工项链既能体现当地传统，也能为农村社区的手工艺人带来收入。

tip: 结尾-lace读/ləs/，不是单词lace的读音。

senses.en: A place where two sides, walls, or streets meet.
To trap someone so they cannot escape or avoid answering.

ex.en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
ex.zh: 我们在角落里放了一盏小灯。

ex.en: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 街角商店让当地居民更方便地获得日常服务，从而鼓励人们步行。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: 室内角落用in the corner；街道拐角常用on或at。

senses.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape
gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh
not strict or severe enough

ex.en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。

ex.en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。

tip: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

senses.en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.

ex.en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
ex.zh: 打开之前，它看起来就是一个普通盒子。

ex.en: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
ex.zh: 城市规划应反映普通居民的需求，而不是只顾吸引富有的投资者。

tip: ordinary强调不特别；不等于表示平均水平的average。

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells
a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance

ex.en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
ex.zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

ex.en: Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.
ex.zh: 严格的枪支存放规定有助于预防事故，提高当地社区的安全水平。

col: a loaded gun｜装有弹药的枪
tip: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。

tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

senses.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand
to touch or handle something with your fingers

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

senses.en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious.
An anxious feeling or something that causes it.

ex.en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
ex.zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。

ex.en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。

tip: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
ex.zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。

ex.en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
ex.zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。

col: in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。
